name: Street Rods by Dowdy
summary: Street Rods by Dowdy is a specialized custom automotive shop in Dolan Springs, Arizona, focusing on hot rod and street rod fabrication and restoration. With a 4.7-star rating, this Desert Concepts operation serves classic car enthusiasts throughout the southwestern United States.
demographics: The primary customer base consists of middle-aged to older male automotive enthusiasts, typically aged 45-70, with above-average disposable income levels ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+ annually. These customers are passionate hobbyists and collectors who invest significantly in custom vehicle projects and restorations, often traveling from regional markets including Kingman, Bullhead City, and even Las Vegas to access specialized services. The trade area draws from a rural and semi-rural population with strong interests in automotive culture, classic cars, and custom fabrication, representing a niche but dedicated market segment willing to drive considerable distances for quality craftsmanship.
description: Street Rods by Dowdy, operating under Desert Concepts, is a specialized automotive business located in Dolan Springs, Arizona, serving the custom hot rod and street rod enthusiast community. Situated at 18320 Olive Drive in the scenic high desert region of northwestern Arizona, this establishment has built a strong reputation with a 4.7-star rating from 25 customer reviews. The business focuses on custom automotive fabrication, restoration, and street rod building, catering to classic car enthusiasts and collectors throughout the region. With its location in Dolan Springs, a small community between Kingman and Las Vegas, Street Rods by Dowdy serves as a destination shop for automotive enthusiasts seeking quality craftsmanship and specialized services. The facility represents a unique niche business that has become a recognized name in the custom car community of the Southwest.
